children: Lei Zhang, a 10% owner and Chief Executive Officer, reported that Mutong Holdings Limited, an entity he designated and controls, acquired 120,000 Class C ordinary shares on November 25, 2026, for a total purchase amount of $1,243,200, at $10.36 per share. Zhang indirectly owns 120,000 Class C ordinary shares through Mutong Holdings Limited. The per-share price was based on the average closing price of the Company's Class A ordinary shares for the 10 consecutive trading days immediately preceding the share subscription agreement.
